title: Near-System Survey and Preservation Act
summary: Dedicates 0.8000 units of the Assembly channel to a public survey of nearby star systems and to conditional preservation zones around potentially habitable worlds, pending survey. Delayed by the Council; delay overridden.

provisions.heading: Allocation
provisions.text: 0.8000 units of the Assembly channel of the First Term release are allocated to the Near-System Survey and Preservation Programme (the Programme).

provisions.heading: Survey
provisions.text: The Programme shall fund non-invasive survey missions and observatories to assess nearby star systems for potentially habitable worlds and emergent ecologies, and shall publish its findings openly.

provisions.heading: Preservation zones
provisions.text: Claims released under this Act may not be used for irreversible transformation within a designated zone around a potentially habitable world until the survey of that world is published. Zones are designated by the implementing consortium and published in the ledger.

provisions.heading: Antecedent holdings
provisions.text: Nothing in this Act restricts, conditions or reallocates any holding established before the Treaty, including the holdings of the Aster programme and its competitors.

provisions.heading: Implementing actor
provisions.text: A public survey consortium is chartered under this Act, reporting to the Assembly Bureau and subject to audit by an independent verification system.

provisions.heading: Reach and duration
provisions.text: The Programme's reach is near (within the Milky Way). Its authority lasts thirty years from authorisation.

provisions.heading: Success and failure
provisions.text: The Programme succeeds if surveys of at least the nearest candidate systems are published within its duration. It fails if no survey is published before the sunset review.

resource.implementingActor: Public survey consortium chartered under the Act, reporting to the Assembly Bureau
resource.beneficiaries: The public; scientific community; future generations
resource.duration: Thirty years from authorisation, with a sunset review in the Third Term (Amendment 1)
conditions: Preservation zones bind only claims released under this Act.

amendments.summary: Adds a sunset review in the Third Term.
amendments.text: After provision 6, insert: 'The Assembly shall review the Programme in Week 2 of the Third Term. Unless renewed by ordinary majority, preservation zones designated under provision 3 lapse at the end of that term.'

history.action: Filed by Delegate Fomalhaut with the motion particulars required by the Rules of Procedure.
Passed as amended on division (408 – 144, 48 abstaining).
Delayed by four seats of the Council of Treaty Parties.
Arbiter classification: the Act does not fall within a protected matter; no veto applies.
Allocation entered in the resource ledger.

councilActions.basis: Suspensive delay (World Bible §6). The delaying seats also asked the Arbiter whether the Act restricts established probe holdings.
councilActions.text: The seats state that preservation zones near candidate systems could, in practice, restrict missions already en route, and request that the Assembly reconsider.

rulings.question: Does the Act fall within protected matter (1), the seizure or restriction of a Council seat's established holdings?
rulings.holding: No. Provision 3 binds only claims released under this Act, and provision 4 expressly preserves antecedent holdings. The Council's action is a suspensive delay, which the Assembly may override by two-thirds. The ruling may be appealed to the Charter Review Tribunal.

outcome.summary: 0.8000 units allocated and committed; consortium chartered and first instrument contracts let. No survey mission has yet reached a target system.
